verdict.rationale: Pylon documents several in-product AI insight features. Ask AI answers questions about your existing data, and AI Reports schedule automated summaries of it. AI fields roll qualitative signals up into structured, explainable account and contact fields. On the suggestions side, AI Tasks propose follow-ups after calls, and the Assist and Background Agents investigate issues and draft replies. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
